nodes.name: apply-prisma-provider.mjs
nodes.summary: Rewrites the `provider` field in every Prisma schema file under apps/web/prisma to match the current COSMOS_DB_PROVIDER setting (sqlite or postgresql), ensuring schemas stay in sync before code generation or migrations.

nodes.name: db-urls.mjs
nodes.summary: Central utility module that resolves database connection URLs for all Prisma schemas in the monorepo, supporting both SQLite (local dev) and PostgreSQL (production) via environment variable inspection.
nodes.languageNotes: Exports a rich set of helpers (envKeyForSchema, getDbProvider, sqliteDatabaseUrl, postgresDatabaseUrl, databaseUrlForSchema, resolveAllDatabaseUrls) and constants (DB_BY_SCHEMA, WEB_DATABASE_ENV_KEYS) consumed by every other database script.

nodes.name: databaseUrlForSchema
nodes.summary: Returns the fully-resolved database URL for a given Prisma schema name, preferring an explicit env var override and then falling back to provider-specific URL construction (postgres or sqlite).

nodes.name: resolveAllDatabaseUrls
nodes.summary: Iterates all known schemas in DB_BY_SCHEMA and returns a map of environment-variable keys to their resolved database URLs, used to bootstrap multi-schema env injection.

nodes.name: postgresDatabaseUrl
nodes.summary: Builds a PostgreSQL connection URL for a named sub-database by appending the database name to a base URL, with search param normalisation.

nodes.name: migrate-all.ts
nodes.summary: Dev-time script that iterates every Prisma schema in DB_BY_SCHEMA and runs `prisma db push` against each one with the resolved database URL, supporting both SQLite and PostgreSQL providers.

nodes.name: seed-db.ts
nodes.summary: Comprehensive database seeding script for the Cosmos ERP platform that populates all domain-specific Prisma databases (auth, CRM, inventory, orders, WMS, dispatch, compliance, ledger, payments, notifications) with realistic fixture data for development and testing.
nodes.languageNotes: Each seed function dynamically imports a separate Prisma client package at runtime to target the correct sub-database, disconnecting after each domain segment to avoid connection leaks. The main() orchestrator runs all seeders sequentially and also calls syncSnapshotsFromOrders to hydrate computed snapshots.

nodes.name: main
nodes.summary: Top-level orchestrator that calls every domain seeder in dependency order, then syncs order snapshots and prints a summary of inserted record counts.

nodes.name: seedAuth
nodes.summary: Seeds the auth database with a default tenant record and two hashed-password user accounts (admin and viewer) using bcrypt and Prisma upserts.

nodes.name: seedTenantOrg
nodes.summary: Seeds tenant organisation profile, onboarding steps, an invite record, and a webhook subscription into the tenant Prisma database.

nodes.name: seedInventory
nodes.summary: Seeds warehouse locations, bin locations, SKUs, and initial stock levels into the inventory Prisma database for a given tenant.

nodes.name: seedCrm
nodes.summary: Seeds the CRM database with customer records, a lead, CRM activities, and customer-specific price overrides for a given tenant.

nodes.name: seedOrders
nodes.summary: Seeds sample sales orders with line items into the orders Prisma database, using upsert semantics to avoid duplicates across re-runs.

nodes.name: seedWms
nodes.summary: Seeds the WMS database with fulfillment tasks, pick waves, receiving sessions, and cycle count records for warehouse operations testing.

nodes.name: seedCompliance
nodes.summary: Seeds MSA compliance records including tenant registration, manufacturer DIDs, transactions, and reports into the compliance Prisma database.

nodes.name: seedLedger
nodes.summary: Seeds the accounting ledger database with chart-of-account entries and a sample journal entry for double-entry bookkeeping fixtures.

nodes.name: seedTier8Extras
nodes.summary: Seeds advanced tier-8 ERP data including volume price breaks, order templates, additional bin locations, bank accounts, bank statement lines, and POS registers across multiple Prisma databases.

nodes.name: seedNotifications
nodes.summary: Seeds notification requests and updates the tenant's notification preferences in the notifications and tenant Prisma databases.

nodes.name: setup-sqlite.mjs
nodes.summary: Minimal bootstrap script that creates the apps/web/.data directory for local SQLite database files and prints guidance for the next setup steps.
